item.description: Photo credit: PBA Images San Miguel Beermen escapes past winless TerraFirma Dyip, 109-108 in overtime thriller to claim their ninth victory and retain the solo top spot in the standings in the 2022 PBA Philippine Cup on Thursday at the SMART Araneta Coliseum [Buy San Miguel Jersey] June Mar Fajardo led the Beermen and was one assist shy of a triple double of 26 points (10/17 fg, 1/1 3pt, 5/5 ft), 10 rebounds and 9 assists in 41 minutes of play for SMB's sixth straight win.
